_comment: Seed data for the `companies` collection (Company Directory). Reproduces the 'seed script adds examples' feature from the design spec. Compiled from web search 2026-10-20, career URLs confirmed 2026-10-20. All entries verified except note TigerIT has no standalone careers page (atsType: external, points at its Indeed listing instead of a schema.org JobPosting page) — the career-page discovery adapter won't work for it as-is.

companies.name: Brain Station 23
companies.notes: Largest software firm in Bangladesh by headcount (850+ engineers), offices in 6 countries. Uses easy.jobs ATS, not Greenhouse/Lever.

companies.name: BJIT Limited
companies.notes: One of the oldest IT firms in BD (750+ staff); operations in Japan/US/Europe/Singapore.

companies.name: Cefalo Bangladesh
companies.notes: Named repeatedly for strong engineering culture.

companies.name: DataSoft Systems Bangladesh
companies.notes: Software, logistics and automation, 20+ years operating.

companies.name: Kaz Software
companies.notes: Boutique custom-software house, strong client-satisfaction reputation.

companies.name: SELISE Digital Platforms
companies.notes: 700+ employees, staff augmentation / AI / data science. Uses Hirebee ATS.

companies.name: Vivasoft Limited
companies.notes: Named as one of the top overall companies to work for in BD rankings.

companies.name: Enosis Solutions
companies.notes: Repeatedly named among top BD software companies.

companies.name: TigerIT Bangladesh
companies.notes: Biometrics and e-governance, based in Banani, Dhaka. No standalone careers page on their own domain — vacancies are posted on Indeed/LinkedIn instead; the career-page adapter won't apply here, this needs a different discovery path (or manual tracking).

companies.name: Riseup Labs
companies.notes: Software product development and AI consultancy.

companies.name: Dynamic Solution Innovators
companies.notes: Uses Hrythmic ATS for applications, not their own domain.
